anomalies.observed: On the 'Water Level Sensor/Switches' section (sheet 1, region D), the 10 k bias resistors are tied to the opposite float nets than the reference: R6 (10 k) is connected between +3V3 and the FLOAT_HIGH net, and R9 (10 k) between the FLOAT_LOW net and GND. (The 4.7 k resistors R2/R11 are on the correct nets, anchoring that the global labels FLOAT_LOW/FLOAT_HIGH themselves are not swapped.)
anomalies.expected: Per the design specification's reference netlist, R6 is the pull-up on FLOAT_LOW ('R6 FLOAT_LOW +3V3 10k') and R9 is the pull-down on FLOAT_HIGH ('R9 GND FLOAT_HIGH 10k'). The two bias resistors' signal nets should be swapped back so that FLOAT_LOW is pulled up and FLOAT_HIGH is pulled down.

evidence.quote: Two float switches are read as binary_sensor GPIO inputs (GPIO11 'Water Level Low', GPIO12 'Water Level High'), matching the README's float-switch safety feature and the netlist's FLOAT_LOW/FLOAT_HIGH nets (with 10 kΩ/4.7 kΩ pull resistors visible in the .cir file: R6 FLOAT_LOW +3V3 10k, R9 GND FLOAT_HIGH 10k, R2 FLOAT_LOW /BPUMP 4.7k, R11 FLOAT_HIGH /BATO 4.7k).
Sheet 1, 'Water Level Sensor/Switches' (region D): R6 10k from +3V3+3V3 down to the wire labelled FLOAT_HIGH; R9 10k from the wire labelled FLOAT_LOW down to GND; J1 pin2=HIGH, pin3=LOW.

anomalies.impact: The idle bias of the two float inputs is inverted relative to the intended design: FLOAT_LOW is pulled to GND and FLOAT_HIGH to +3V3. This can leave the low-level pump-cutoff interlock (T1, base fed from FLOAT_LOW via R2) and the high-level ATO-overflow interlock (T4, base fed from FLOAT_HIGH via R11) in the wrong permanent state, and make the firmware float binary_sensors read stuck, so the main circulation pump and/or ATO solenoid behave differently from intended (e.g. permanently disabled or never shut off).

parsed.summary: The drawing matches the specification on power rails, the buck/LDO feedback values, the isolated pH/EC channels, the unisolated RTD, the TMC2209 driver set (110 mΩ sense, 14k/10k7 VREF dividers, shared STEP_BUS, distinct UART addresses) and the DNP environmental sensors; the only deviation I can support is that the float-switch bias resistors R6 (pull-up) and R9 (pull-down) are connected to the opposite nets (FLOAT_HIGH/FLOAT_LOW) than the reference netlist specifies, inverting the float interlock idle states.
